description: Dog Food Finder helps dog owners compare dog food options by life stage, breed size, allergies, sensitive stomach needs, picky eating, fresh-food preference, and monthly budget. It ranks options by fit, explains tradeoffs clearly, includes affiliate disclosure before outbound shopping links, and avoids veterinary diagnosis or treatment claims.

defaultPrompt: Find dog food for my adult golden retriever with a chicken allergy under $100/month.
Compare fresh dog food for a picky senior dog with a sensitive stomach.
Find fresh dog food options for a large-breed puppy and explain the tradeoffs.
